message.content:
**1) Page/Section Title**
Keyboard shortcuts

**2) Banners, Toasts, or Notices (Verbatim Text)**
*   **Toast/Notice (Bottom Center):** "Connection lost. Reconnecting..." with a "Dismiss" button.

**3) Main Content**
*   **Search Bar:** Contains placeholder text "Search shortcuts" and a "Keys" button to the right.
*   **List of Shortcuts (Rows):** Each row displays an action title, a description, and the corresponding keyboard shortcut keys.
    *   **Row 1:**
        *   Title: New chat
        *   Description: Start a new Codex chat
        *   Keys: `Ctrl` `N` (and fn/modifier icons)
    *   **Row 2:**
        *   Title: Archive chat
        *   Description: Archive the current chat
        *   Keys: `Ctrl` `Shift` `A`
    *   **Row 3:**
        *   Title: New standalone chat
        *   Description: Start a new chat outside of any project
        *   Keys: `Ctrl` `Alt` `O`
    *   **Row 4:**
        *   Title: Open side chat
        *   Description: Start a temporary side conversation without leaving this chat
        *   Keys: `Ctrl` `Alt` `S`
    *   **Row 5:**
        *   Title: Toggle pin
        *   Description: Pin or unpin the current chat
        *   Keys: `Ctrl` `Alt` `P`
    *   **Row 6:**
        *   Title: Mark chat unread
        *   Description: Toggle the unread indicator for the current chat
        *   Keys: `Ctrl` `Shift` `U`
    *   **Row 7 (Partially Visible):**
        *   Title: Clear all unread indicators

**4) Left Sidebar Selected Item**
*   **Selected Item:** Keyboard shortcuts (located under the "Personal" section).
